mapper.select: SELECT aer.id, pap.assessment_name, p.name as patient_name, p.gender, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, p.birth_date, CURDATE()) as age, p.medical_record_no as medical_record_number, p.disease_type, p.enrollment_institution, aer.execution_institution, aer.status, aer.prescribing_doctor, aer.created_time, aer.updated_time FROM assessment_execution_record aer LEFT JOIN patient_assessment_plan pap ON aer.assessment_plan_id = pap.id LEFT JOIN patient p ON aer.patient_id = p.id WHERE aer.id = #{id}
